# Warlock AI Tools

> Package: `@warlock.js/ai-tools`

> Ready-made agent tools (web search, fetch, HTTP, calculator, date-time) + an MCP client/server for @warlock.js/ai

## Skills

- [connect-mcp-server](@warlock.js/ai-tools/connect-mcp-server/SKILL.md): Connect a @warlock.js/ai agent to an external Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and adapt its tools as native agent tools (Direction A) with `ai.mcp(server)`. Triggers: `signal`, `ai.mcp(`, `ai.mcp.serve` (the other direction), `mcp(`, `McpClient`, `McpClientOptions`, `McpTransport`, `client.tools()`, `client.close()`, `namePrefix`, `filter`, `McpTransportError`, `{ type: "stdio" }`, `{ type: "http" }`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, `jsonSchemaToStandard`, `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`, `ajv`; 'consume an MCP server', 'use an external MCP server's tools in my agent', 'connect to the GitHub/Slack/Filesystem MCP server', 'adapt MCP tools as agent tools', 'bridge my agent to the MCP ecosystem', 'run an MCP server over stdio/http'; typical import `import "@warlock.js/ai-tools"; import { ai } from "@warlock.js/ai"`. Skip: exposing YOUR agent/tools AS an MCP server (the reverse direction) — the `expose-as-mcp-server` topic; the built-in web/HTTP/calc/date tools — the `use-web-and-http-tools` topic.
- [expose-as-mcp-server](@warlock.js/ai-tools/expose-as-mcp-server/SKILL.md): Expose a @warlock.js/ai agent / supervisor / orchestrator (or a raw ToolContract[], or named tool groups) AS a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server other clients consume (Direction B) with `ai.mcp.serve(source, options)` — over stdio or authenticated Streamable HTTP. Triggers: `ai.mcp.serve(`, `serve(`, `createServeHandler`, `McpServer`, `McpServeOptions`, `McpServeSource`, `McpServeTransport`, `McpHttpServeTransport`, `McpHttpAuth`, `McpServeError`, `server.start()`, `server.stop()`, `{ url, close }`, `{ type: "http", host, port, path, auth }`, `bearer`, `authorize`, `authenticate`, `beforeCall`, `listFilter`, `validateCallParams`, `McpError`, `routes`, `McpHttpRouteContext`, `requestId`, `principal`, `notifications/cancelled`, `allowedOrigins`, `maxBodyBytes`, `prefixToolNames`, `groups`, `resources`, `prompts`, `ctx.request.headers`, `schemaTarget`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, `{ type: "stdio" }`; 'expose my agent as an MCP server', 'serve my tools over HTTP', 'give each agent session its own MCP endpoint', 'protect my MCP server with a token', 'publish my tools to Cursor/Claude Desktop', 'serve MCP resources or prompts', 'tool name collision'; typical import `import "@warlock.js/ai-tools"; import { ai } from "@warlock.js/ai"`. Skip: CONSUMING an external MCP server (the reverse direction) — the `connect-mcp-server` topic; the built-in web/HTTP/calc/date tools — the `use-web-and-http-tools` topic.
- [use-web-and-http-tools](@warlock.js/ai-tools/use-web-and-http-tools/SKILL.md): Wire the @warlock.js/ai-tools belt — web search, fetch/scrape, HTTP/REST, calculator, date-time — into an agent under their guardrails. Triggers: `ai.tools.measure`, `measureTools`, `ai.tools.webSearch`, `ai.tools.fetchUrl`, `ai.tools.http`, `ai.tools.calculator`, `ai.tools.dateTime`, `webSearchTool`, `fetchUrlTool`, `httpRequestTool`, `calculatorTool`, `dateTimeTool`, `web_search`, `fetch_url`, `http_request`, `calculator`, `date_time`, `WebToolError`, `HttpPolicyError`, `CalculatorError`, `DateTimeError`, `allowHosts`, `allowMethods`, `allowPrivateNetwork`, `baseUrl`, `maxBytes`, `guardedFetch`, `SearchProvider`, `TAVILY_API_KEY`; 'give an agent web search', 'let an agent fetch/scrape a page', 'let an agent call a REST API', 'restrict which hosts/methods an agent can hit', 'add a calculator/date tool to an agent', 'SSRF guardrail for an agent tool', 'let a tool reach an internal/dev service'; typical import `import "@warlock.js/ai-tools"; import { ai } from "@warlock.js/ai"`. Skip: connecting to an external MCP server — the `connect-mcp-server` topic; exposing tools AS an MCP server — the `expose-as-mcp-server` topic; filesystem/shell tools — the `use-a-workspace` topic of the `warlock-js-ai-workspace` skill; defining your own custom tool — the `define-ai-tool` topic of the `warlock-js-ai` skill.
